model: transformer d_model=384 n_heads=6 n_layers=6 d_ff=1536 params=10929408
data: 40000 train docs, 400 validation docs, single epoch not exceeded

evaluation.protocol: generation capped at 128 tokens; rescored on validation documents with reference length 8 to 112 characters

observations: Validation loss falls from 1.6367 to 1.2781 between 6.3M and 19.7M tokens, then only to 1.2428 at 62.9M tokens
Training loss keeps falling (2.00 to 1.12) while validation loss plateaus, which is the onset of memorisation rather than generalisation
Predictions are plausible English titles such as composition and, chart performance, service history, unrelated to the reference
Character accuracy on short documents rises from 8.76 to 11.21 percent against an 8.43 percent constant-space baseline
The residual gains are consistent with plaintext language modelling, not with recovery of the cipher
